name: Stable Unlabeled Complexity of K4 Incidence with Empty Set
proof: The one-pass stable unlabeled construction in survey Proposition \ref{prop:one-pass-stable-unlabeled} bounds sUSC by Littlestone dimension, which is two on this class. Conversely a shattered pair has four labelings but a width-one unlabeled encoder can use only its empty and two singleton keys, so width one cannot cover all four labelings. Improper reconstruction is permitted for this parameter.
